id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

textData.description: Holds the file content for the code editor.

height.description: The height of the code editor.

width.description: The width of the code editor.

content.description:
Holds the code editor content when it does not come from an existing file.
i.e. New file, Content generated in memory, etc....

editState.description: Whether or not the code editor should be read only along with the list of disabled buttons names.

wrap.description:
Whether the text of the code editor should wrap.
If false, users will have to horizontally scroll to see the overflowed content.
If true, the overflowed content will wrap to the next line.

theme.description:
Color theme for the code editor.
Two C3 provided themes are `DARK` and `LIGHT`.
If set to `AUTO`, the code editor will use the current application theme.
Other available themes are at: https://github.com/ajaxorg/ace/tree/v1.31.1/src/theme

language.description: The programming language of the code editor's content.

saveSpec.description:
A spec describing how to save the code editor contents. By default, saving is done through
the `TagMetadataStore`.

title: The following type represents the UI Code Editor Component.
name: UiSdlCodeEditor
